info.description: REST API exposed by the debyut api-gateway. The gateway translates these HTTP calls into gRPC requests to the auth, users, and event services.
info.title: debyut API Gateway

post.description: The slug is generated from the name when omitted. Slug and icon must be lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; icon is a key from the frontend's icon set.

parameters.description: Match against organization name or email
parameters.name: search

post.description: Marks the application approved, creates the organization with the applicant as its OWNER, and gives the applicant the ORGANIZER role. The new role appears in the applicant's next access token (after a refresh).
Marks the application declined. The applicant may submit a new application afterwards.
Emails a one-time password to a registered address. Calling it again resends the code (1-minute cooldown).

post.summary: Revoke all refresh tokens for the current user

post.description: Reads the refresh token from the httpOnly refreshToken cookie, rotates it, sets a new cookie, and returns a fresh access token in the body.
post.summary: Rotate the refresh token (from httpOnly cookie) for a new access token

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Emails a one-time password to an address that is not yet registered. Calling it again resends the code (1-minute cooldown). The code expires after 5 minutes or 5 wrong attempts.
Creates the account for the verified email, stores the profile, and logs the user in. Surname is optional; agreeToTerms must be true; the user must be at least 18.

400.description: Validation error, under-age, terms not accepted, or registration token expired

post.description: Exchanges a valid OTP for a registration token (valid 30 minutes) that authorizes completing the profile.

get.summary: List pending invitations for the current user's email

post.description: Joins the organization with the invited role. The invitation must be addressed to the current user's email. The user gets the ORGANIZER role (visible after the next token refresh).

400.description: Invitation expired, revoked, or already answered

put.description: Replaces the profile fields, including the newsletter opt-in. Users must stay 18+.
Replaces the avatar with a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 2 MB.

400.description: Missing, too large, or unsupported image

get.summary: List organizations the current user belongs to

get.description: Only members can see an organization; for anyone else it does not exist.

put.description: Changes the organization's name and description. The email is verified at application time and cannot be changed here.
Replaces the avatar with a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 2 MB.

400.description: Missing, too large, or unsupported image

get.summary: List an organization's pending invitations (owners only)

post.description: Emails an invitation to join as OWNER or STAFF. The address does not need a debyut account yet. Invitations expire after 7 days; one pending invitation per email per organization.
post.summary: Invite someone to an organization (owners only)

409.description: This email already has a pending invitation

404.description: Organization or pending invitation not found

delete.description: Owners can remove anyone; any member can remove themselves. The last owner cannot be removed. A user who leaves their last organization goes back to the USER role.
delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave an organization

post.description: Submits the application for admin review using the verified organization email. Users and existing organizers can apply (an organizer applies to create another organization). A user may have one pending application at a time and can apply again after a decline.
post.summary: Submit the organizer application (step 3 — Work with us)

400.description: Validation error, or email verification expired

post.description: Emails a one-time password to the organization's email. Calling it again resends the code (1-minute cooldown). The code expires after 5 minutes or 5 wrong attempts.
post.summary: Verify the organization email (step 1 — email OTP)

post.description: Exchanges a valid OTP for a verification token (valid 30 minutes) that authorizes submitting the application.
